doug: I approved via PR #4321 — https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4321. Approval recorded (SSO + signed commit). I can attach the PR + commit hash.
marisa: Attaching snippets: k8s audit excerpt + KMS rotation event from CloudTrail. See below.
